caption: The drawing depicts an ornate chair in a frontal view. The chair has a high, wide backrest that is rectangular with a slightly curved top, and there is intricate, symmetrical carved detailing at the top center. Both the backrest and the seat cushion are colored a soft, light pink. The edges of the seat cushion feature a yellow or gold trim. The frame of the chair, including the legs and structural sections, is outlined in black ink, with the legs drawn in a classical style featuring turned detailing. The chair's design is further embellished with circular rosette motifs beneath the seat and on the top crest. The background of the image is plain and beige, with no additional objects present.
title: Chair
